content.text: A new episode of "American Idol" season 24 will air on Monday, April 6 on ABC (photo courtesy of American Idol on YouTube).American Idol/ABCIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Ariana Tourangeau | atourangeau@masslive.comThe top 12 perform 90s hits secretly picked by Luke Bryan, Lionel Richie, or Carrie Underwood in a new episode of “American Idol” airing on Monday, April 6. The new episode will air at 8 p.m. ET on ABC. Those without cable can watch the show for free through FuboTV or DIRECTV, each of which offers a free trial to new users.
